info.name: Internship Management API
info.description: Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (server must be running on baseUrl). Requests run in order and share variables.

exec: pm.test("Message is API is running", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("API is running"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Route not found: GET /api/nothing"); });
pm.test("No password in response", function () { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.not.include("password"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A user with this email already exists"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Valid email is required"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password must be at least 6 characters"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password is required"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Access denied. No token provided"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A student with this email already exists"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Valid email is required"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Name is required"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid JSON in request body"); });
pm.test("Every student has course CSE", function () { pm.response.json().data.forEach(function (s) { pm.expect(s.course).to.eql("CSE"); }); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Student not found"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid student ID"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Student not found"); });
